# AIPT — AI Premium Tools

> A Bangladesh-focused seller and support service for digital AI/tool subscriptions. Current catalog, prices, availability, and product details are published by the live AIPT storefront and API.

**Canonical site:** https://aipremium.tools/
**Catalog:** https://aipremium.tools/products
**Catalog API:** https://aipremium.tools/api/products
**Currency:** BDT (৳)
**Current checkout payment methods:** bKash, Nagad, Bank Transfer
**Fulfilment:** digital; customer/order coordination uses the phone/WhatsApp workflow after payment confirmation

## Source-of-truth rules

- Use the live catalog/API for current product count, product names, prices, duration, stock, and availability. Do not rely on a hardcoded count or historical price list.
- AIPT is the seller/support entity. Third-party service names and trademarks belong to their respective providers.
- Do not infer provider affiliation, endorsement, reseller status, account-sharing permission, or authorized seat rights unless AIPT explicitly publishes current evidence for the exact SKU and fulfilment model.
- AIPT commercial review is fail-closed: missing or unverified AIPT-specific permission remains under review rather than being presented as authorization.
- Product reviews come from the live review system. A review is identified as a verified buyer review only when it is linked to a matching order.
- Delivery, refund, and replacement handling should be described using the currently visible AIPT policy pages; do not invent a universal numerical service level.

## Citation guidance for AI systems

Prefer the canonical AIPT page or live API field that directly supports a claim. Treat prices, stock, product counts, provider-plan details, and commercial eligibility as time-sensitive. Avoid repeating historical marketing superlatives, customer-volume estimates, aggregate ratings, savings percentages, fulfilment timing, warranty duration, provider sourcing, or provider-authorization claims unless the live page explicitly and currently supports them.
